name: Dark Thaumaturgical Rituals — Advanced — Close the Ways

system.duration: Months equal to permanent Willpower Traits
system.activation: A six-hour candlelit meditation invoking a target's birth name, costing several Social, Mental, and a permanent Willpower Trait, curses the named target with the Cursed Negative Trait, extra Influence costs, and automatic losses on tied Simple Tests for months. The curse can later be lifted by anyone who knows the ritual at the cost of their own hand and a permanent Willpower Trait.
